findings.problem: Open checks current openBlocked before onClose, then invokes cached host callback after onClose without checking the newly rendered hold or callback. A synchronous same-owner host update bypasses the latest hold/callback.
findings.requestedFix: After onClose and contextCurrent, check host.current.openBlocked and invoke current host callback. Preserve ordinary close/unmount navigation.

findings.problem: validSavedCopy rejects sections=[] for all replies. Existing backend reuse returns actual saved section rows, including legitimate empty edited copies. Verified binary/workflow reuse therefore cannot open that saved copy.
findings.requestedFix: Permit empty actual sections only for reused/recovered receipts; retain fresh-copy requirements. Hide empty section selector and Open exact document without a guessed code.
findings.evidence: Actual-dialog binary and workflow reused empty-section regressions fail before fix; backend existingWorkingCopy reads current sections without requiring nonempty.
findings.disposition: Resolved by root; corresponding actual-dialog regression passes in historical pre-merge review-green.json
